title: Circadian & Sleep Analysis App: Technical Specification
description: Machine-readable specification of inputs, parameters, algorithms, outputs and visualisations for circadian and sleep analysis of DAM, ethoscope and generic behavioural data.
notes: Verify defaults and references against the original papers before release.

time_conventions.CT0: subjective dawn (ZT0 projected from last LD cycle)

dead_animal_rule_h.note: No activity for this long = dead

input_adapters.name: TriKinetics DAM (DAM2/DAM5)
input_adapters.format: tab-separated text, one row per time bin (usually 1 min)

input_adapters.name: Ethoscope SQLite
input_adapters.format: SQLite .db, tables ROI_1..ROI_20 plus METADATA, VAR_MAP, ROI_MAP

classification.moving_if: max velocity > threshold (default 1.0 after velocity correction)

activity_metrics.formula: mean of A_day(d) over selected days
sum of x_i with light=1 / light=0

algorithm: find runs of consecutive immobile bins
mark runs >= min_sleep_duration as sleep, from run start
build bout table (start, end, duration, truncated flag)

outputs.formula: asleep minutes in light / dark phase
count of bouts starting in window
total sleep minutes / number of bouts
minutes from lights-off (or on) to first sleep bout start
awake minutes between first sleep onset and end of dark phase
bouts per hour of sleep, or per day

circadian_methods.name: Chi-square periodogram
circadian_methods.formula: Qp = K * N' * sum_h (M_h - M)^2 / sum_i (X_i - M)^2
circadian_methods.definitions: P trial period in bins; K = floor(N/P); N' = K*P; M_h column means; M grand mean
circadian_methods.significance: chi-square critical value, df = P - 1, alpha = 0.05
outputs: tau = P at max Qp * bin

circadian_methods.name: Lomb-Scargle periodogram
circadian_methods.formula: PN(w) = 1/(2 s^2) [ (sum (x_j - xbar) cos(w(t_j - tau_LS)))^2 / sum cos^2(w(t_j - tau_LS)) + (sum (x_j - xbar) sin(w(t_j - tau_LS)))^2 / sum sin^2(w(t_j - tau_LS)) ]

circadian_methods.name: Autocorrelation
circadian_methods.formula: r_k = sum_{i=1..N-k} (x_i - xbar)(x_{i+k} - xbar) / sum (x_i - xbar)^2
outputs: period = lag of highest peak after lag 0

circadian_methods.name: Fourier spectrum
circadian_methods.formula: X(f_k) = sum x_n exp(-2*pi*i*k*n/N); Power = |X|^2 / N; period = 1/f

circadian_methods.name: Cosinor
circadian_methods.formula: y = M + beta*cos(w t) + gamma*sin(w t); A = sqrt(beta^2 + gamma^2); phi = atan2(-gamma, beta)

circadian_methods.name: Onset-based period
circadian_methods.formula: tau = 24 + slope of onset time vs day
circadian_methods.onset_rule: first crossing of 20% of max smoothed daily activity, sustained

nonparametric_indices.formula: mean of most active 10 h of mean 24 h profile
mean of least active 5 h of mean 24 h profile
atan2(sum x_i sin(theta_i), sum x_i cos(theta_i)), theta_i = 2*pi*tod_i / T

anticipation_indices.general: A(t_transition - 3 h, t_transition) / A(t_transition - 6 h, t_transition)

anticipation_indices.formula: linear regression slope of normalised activity vs time in the last 3-6 h

anticipation_settings.na_rule: NA if A(last 6 h) == 0 or counts below minimum

steps: mean over days per animal and bin

profiles.variable: minutes asleep per hour or % per bin

profiles.description: animals on rows, time on x, state as colour

actograms.layout: row d = day d, x = 0-24 h
row d = days d and d+1, x = 0-48 h

actograms.method: per-animal normalisation, then mean/median per day and bin
actograms.dd_note: align to own onset/phase or tau if taus differ

quality_control: equidistant bins; fill gaps with NA
dead animal removal after 24 h without activity
exclude animals with excessive missing data
validation: compare with ShinyR-DAM, Rethomics/sleepr, ClockLab, SCAMP, pySolo
synthetic signals with known tau (23.5, 24, 25 h) plus noise and gaps
property tests: no sleep bout < 5 min; sum of binned sleep = total sleep
references: Levine, Funes, Dowse, Hall 2002, BMC Neurosci 3:1
Van Someren et al. 1999, Chronobiol Int 16:505-518
